ic_name: DALI (Digital Addressable Lighting Interface, IEC 62386 via TI SLAA422A)

fsm_states_control_gear.name: POWER_UP
fsm_states_control_gear.description: Hardware reset. TI_DALI_Init() loads RAM from flash, configures Timer_A3 PWM, WDT+ interval, enables interrupts. Actual Level := Power On Level (within 600 ms).

fsm_states_control_gear.name: IDLE_WAIT_FOR_FORWARD
fsm_states_control_gear.description: Bus idle (HIGH); poll DALI_RX edge interrupt.

fsm_states_control_gear.name: DECODE_FORWARD_START
fsm_states_control_gear.description: Start bit detected (LOW→HIGH mid-bit). CPU starts Manchester bit-clock.

fsm_states_control_gear.name: DECODE_FORWARD_BITS
fsm_states_control_gear.description: Shift-reg 16 bits: address byte + data byte (MSB first). Manchester violations → silent discard.

fsm_states_control_gear.name: DECODE_FORWARD_STOP
fsm_states_control_gear.description: Verify 2 stop bits HIGH for ≥ 2 × bit-time.

fsm_states_control_gear.name: VALIDATE_ADDRESS
fsm_states_control_gear.description: YAAAAAAB match: short / group / broadcast / special-command.

fsm_states_control_gear.name: EXECUTE_COMMAND
fsm_states_control_gear.description: B=0 → direct level; B=1 → indirect command dispatch.

fsm_states_control_gear.name: FADE_RUNNING
fsm_states_control_gear.description: WDT+ ISR steps Actual Level toward Target at configured Fade Rate.

fsm_states_control_gear.name: PREPARE_BACKWARD
fsm_states_control_gear.description: If query, build single-byte payload; wait 7×TE settle.

fsm_states_control_gear.name: SEND_BACKWARD
fsm_states_control_gear.description: Drive DALI_TX for 1 start + 8 data + 2 stop Manchester at 1200 baud.

fsm_states_control_gear.name: WAIT_INTERFRAME_SETTLE
fsm_states_control_gear.description: Enforce ≥ 22×TE (9.17 ms) before next forward; 13.5 ms recommended.

fsm_states_control_gear.name: CONFIG_MODE
fsm_states_control_gear.description: Entered on INITIALIZE. Dispatch RANDOMIZE/COMPARE/WITHDRAW/SEARCH/PROGRAM/VERIFY/QUERY SHORT ADDRESS. Auto-exit at 15 min or TERMINATE.

fsm_states_control_gear.name: FLASH_UPDATE
fsm_states_control_gear.description: TI_DALI_Flash_Update() writes modified RAM variables back before VCC drops below 2.2 V.

fsm_states_control_gear.name: SYSTEM_FAILURE
fsm_states_control_gear.description: Bus voltage < 9.5 V → Actual Level := System Failure Level.

fsm_hints.validation_order: Frame integrity → address match → command dispatch → fade/PWM or backward.
fsm_hints.broadcast_handling: Address Y=1 + AAAAAA=111111 → every gear executes. Queries shall NOT be broadcast.
fsm_hints.abort_conditions: Manchester violation / missing stop bits / inside settling window → silent discard.
fsm_hints.config_mode_timeout: 15 minutes after INITIALIZE if no further command.
fsm_hints.two_strike_rule: Destructive commands shall be sent twice within 100 ms.

anti_deadlock_rule: Strictly request/optional-reply, master-driven. Only the control device initiates forward frames. Backward frames are sent only by the addressed gear in response to a query, in a deterministic 7..22 TE window. Broadcast queries are part of the addressing iteration; the protocol resolves them via the wired-AND bus + RANDOMIZE/SEARCH ADDRESS bisection.
exit_from_reset_or_power_up: After hardware reset: (1) TI_DALI_Init() loads RAM from flash, (2) configures Timer_A3 (TASSEL_2+ID_0+MC_0+TACLR, TACCR0=5000, TACCTL1/2=CM_0+CCIS_2+OUTMOD_3), (3) enables interrupts, (4) sets Actual Level := Power On Level. Within 600 ms after power-up, if no command arrives the gear automatically applies Power On Level.

fade_logic.fastest_fade_time: 25 ms across 254 levels (needs ≈ 10 kHz tick; would require 10.16 MHz core to use WDT+)
fade_logic.implementation_note: Spec footnote in §3.2 notes 10.16 MHz WDT+ tick is impossible (minimum interval is 64 cycles → would need 650 MHz input); the WDT+ may be replaced by a Timer_A module for fastest rates.

exception_response_logic.trigger: DALI has no exception frame. Faults exposed via QUERY STATUS (0x90) and dedicated queries.
exception_response_logic.no_nack: No negative-acknowledge — rejected commands silently dropped.
exception_response_logic.client_action: Control device polls status via QUERY STATUS / QUERY LAMP FAILURE / QUERY LIMIT ERROR.

interrupt_priority_order: DALI_RX edge interrupt — highest priority for Manchester bit timing.
WDT+ interval interrupt — fade-tick clock (≈ 1 ms).
Timer_A3 CCR interrupt — PWM update on TI_DALI_Update_Callback.
